correctness.rationale: Both endpoints force the odd residue mod 2, which covers every odd offset. For an even-offset subset T, asking for all selected offsets to remain uncovered while both endpoints are coprime excludes exactly the distinct residues in {0,-h} union {-j:j in T} at each odd prime less than h. CRT multiplies those local choices and inclusion–exclusion gives the displayed count, also when a prime divides h and the endpoint exclusions coincide. An independent exact computation directly enumerated the endpoint-admissible wheel for primes up to 13 and applied inclusion–exclusion over the even offsets left uncovered, with Gray-code updates for the remaining primes. It completed all 31 even lengths from 4 through 64 and matched every CSV row, including all nine displayed values. Exact fraction summation reproduced 61370211356863231369/29555095284933631875. These are local finite residue classes, not pairs of consecutive primes.
residual_risks: Does not determine the infinite tail or prove a prime-gap frequency. The original binaries were not run; the separate replay checks the complete claimed finite range.
